renderer.decision: The live renderer is the Phaser code inlined in frontend/index.html: Flask serves that file for the browser at '/', Electron loads '/electron-standalone', which is frontend/electron-standalone.html - a snapshot copied from the same authored page. frontend/game.js is loaded by no shipped page, so it is a legacy reference and never an authority. For every asset the contract therefore records one geometry: the authored page's slicing, kept honest by the file dimensions on disk, which must divide it exactly.

surfaces.note: the only file a person edits for the web view
ensure_electron_standalone_snapshot() copies frontend/index.html here when the file is missing, so its asset declarations must match the authored page - a difference is a conflict
surfaces.served_by: backend/app.py electron_standalone_page(); electron-shell/main.js loads that URL into its windows

surfaces.note: no shipped page references this file; mainline records the same (SOU-88 follow-up commit b9fe446: 'index.html loads NO game.js - frontend/game.js is a stale copy and editing it does nothing'). Parsed for drift only, never authoritative
